title: Off Spin Drift And Dip (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son, off spin bowling
The ball drifts in, dips, then turns away
Three things happening at once
Pay attention

[Verse 1]
Grip the ball across the seam with top joint
Index finger bent, middle finger at the point
Release the ball with index finger flick
Off spin rotation, clockwise, makes it stick

Drift in the air toward the right hander leg
Dip at the crease, bounce lower on the peg
Turn away off the pitch after it lands
Off spin drift and dip, that is how it stands

[Pre-Chorus]
Drift in, dip down, turn away
Three phases in the off spin play
Flight high, loop big, land and turn
Off spin drift and dip, always learn

[Chorus]
Off spin drift and dip, three things at once
Drift to leg, dip at the crease, no stunts
Bounce and turn away, right hander trapped
Off spin drift and dip, perfectly mapped

[Verse 2]
Flighting the ball means tossing it up slow
Tempt the batter to come down the track below
Over spin on top means dip at the end
Off spin drift and dip, around the bend

[Bridge]
Bluey: He has tossed it up, it has drifted, dipped, and turned, beaten outside the edge
Trevor: Three hundred revolutions per minute generates the Magnus effect drift
Chas: Son I say, drift in, dip down, turn away, three things, always three

[Chorus]
Off spin drift and dip, three things at once
Drift to leg, dip at the crease, no stunts
Bounce and turn away, right hander trapped
Off spin drift and dip, perfectly mapped

[Outro]
Drift in
Dip down
Turn away
Thats my boy
